card.name: Inside URLs and code identifiers
card.fires_on: Pieces in the middle of web addresses, file paths and technical identifiers, such as 'ov' in nc-ov, '_sys' in httpd_sys_content_t, or '.org' in a link, where the next piece is predictable.

modes.label: URL pieces
modes.description: Partway through a web address, just before a path or the rest of a site name.

modes.label: Security label parts
modes.description: Inside SELinux-style type names like httpd_sys_content_t.

modes.label: Code constants
modes.description: Inside dotted or underscored code names in programming text.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of web links and computer file or code names, where the rest of the name is easy to guess.
